svg.title: Induction on length bounds the number of allowed routes from any starting bond by P n d , including routes with repeated bonds. Attach to every route node the radius-mB halo of both bond endpoints. The full receipt is the union of these halos. If d + 2 ≤mB, successive halos meet. Each halo has B-cover number at most steady(m) = ballCost(m + 1). The union therefore has cover number at most
